## Relevant Learning Standards

20. Explaining how evidence from a sample supports conclusions about a population while acknowledging sampling variability and uncertainty.
21. Assess the normality of a variable using multiple diagnostic approaches and use those results to select between parametric and non-parametric statistical tests. 
22. Construct and interpret confidence intervals, explaining how factors such as sample size and spatial scale affect the precision of an estimate.

:::
